drills.desc: Long/Short Step Backpedal, Sideways Shuffle
drills.key: Watch their hips during the transition from shuffle to backpedal. Remind them to stay low in the tunnel

drills.name: Agility: 4-Way Direction Change
drills.desc: Feet chopping with 4-way direction change
drills.key: React instantly to the coach's hand signals; keep feet buzzing and center of gravity low

drills.desc: Bear Crawls into Roll & Pop Up
drills.key: Builds core strength and teaches kids how to safely fall and pop back into a football stance

drills.desc: Lobsters, Swoop Drill
drills.key: Swoop into a low coiled contact posture; come to a complete controlled stop

drills.desc: Rip Drill (Elbow-Dip-Rip), Swim Drill (Stagger-Hinge-Swim), Fake Rip Spin
drills.key: Focus on the violent arm movements to clear blocks vertically, not horizontally

drills.name: Agility: M Drill
drills.desc: 5 cones configured in 'M' pattern (10x10 yds). Athlete sprints to cone 1, shuffles across to cone 2, backpedals diagonally to cone 3, sprints forward to cone 4, and breaks down at cone 5
drills.key: Plant hard on the outside foot when changing directions. Drop hips to avoid false steps

drills.name: Agility: Timed 40-Yard / 20-Yard Dash
drills.desc: Stopwatch, cones at 0, 20, and 40 yards. Player starts in 3-point or 2-point sprinter stance behind line. Sprint through finish line at maximum acceleration
drills.key: Focus on forward arm drive (cheek to pocket) rather than side-to-side rotation

drills.name: Agility: Pro-Agility 5-10-5 Shuttle
drills.desc: Cones at 5, 10, 15 yards. Sprint 5 yds right, touch line, sprint 10 yds left, touch line, sprint 5 yds through middle
drills.key: Emphasize touching the line with the outside hand to force them to drop their center of gravity and plant firmly on the outside foot

drills.name: Agility: 3-Cone L-Drill
drills.desc: Set cones in L-cone shape. Sprint 5 yds, touch line, sprint back, loop outside cone, figure-8 around middle cone
drills.key: Tight turns around the cones; dip the inside shoulder to maintain speed

drills.name: Agility: Coach Dave Says (Discipline Sprints)
drills.desc: Full team lined up on goal line / LOS. Team lines up in stance. Coach uses various vocal cadences (Ready Go, Hut 1, Hut 2). Players must sprint 10-15 yards only on the live snap cadence
drills.key: If anyone jumps offsides, team is pushed back 5 yards. Teach them to key the ball movement or the exact sound, turning discipline into a fun game

drills.name: Agility: Tennis Ball Reaction Drill
drills.desc: Coach stands with tennis balls in front of the players. Player backpedals or shuffles; coach drops or bounces a tennis ball unpredictably. Player must react, change direction, sprint, and catch the ball before the second bounce
drills.key: Great for defensive backs and linebackers to develop twitch reflexes. Remind them to break off their outside foot and drive the arms

drills.name: Agility: Agility Ladder
drills.desc: Set up 2-3 agility ladders. Players run through doing icky shuffle, two-in, and lateral quick steps
drills.key: Keep the line moving fast. Keep eyes up rather than staring at the ground

drills.name: Agility: Tackle Jack (Shuffle & Change Direction)
drills.desc: Player starts in breakdown stance circling Tackle Jack circular dummy. 1st whistle = shuffle in circle; 2nd whistle = change direction immediately; 3rd whistle = swoop and tackle
drills.key: Improves lateral agility and the ability to transition from moving sideways to exploding downhill

drills.name: Agility: W-Drill (Backpedal & Drive)
drills.desc: 5 cones in W shape 5 yards apart. Backpedal with chest over toes to Cone 1, plant outside foot, drive 45 degrees forward to Cone 2
drills.key: Low center of gravity!. No hopping or clicking heels together during transition

drills.name: Offense QB: Under Center Snap & Drop
drills.desc: Center snaps to QB. QB executes 3-step or 5-step drop on air. Coach watches feet to ensure no false steps or heel clicking
drills.key: For youth QBs, mastering the snap exchange without fumbling is step one. Ensure the QB is applying firm pressure to the center's backside

drills.name: Offense QB: Shotgun Snap & Quick Game
drills.desc: QB takes shotgun snap. Instantly sets feet and throws a quick slant or hitch to a target. Focus on catching and throwing in one rhythm
drills.key: Eliminate the extra pat or wind-up. Catch the lace-up chest delivery, step to the target, and release

drills.name: Offense QB: Play-Action Bootleg Mesh
drills.desc: QB executes a hard run fake to the back, drops the ball to the hip, snaps head around, and sprints to the edge to deliver a pass
drills.key: Teach the QB to carry out the fake for two full steps with empty hands to freeze the linebackers before rolling out

drills.name: Offense QB: Target Accuracy Net Drill
drills.desc: Set up a net or targets at 5, 10, and 15 yards. QBs drop back and throw 5 passes to each target aiming for the center pocket
drills.key: Focus on the lower body mechanics—ensure the front toe points exactly at the target net upon release

drills.name: Offense QB: On-Run & Off-Platform Throws
drills.desc: Rolling right and left throwing on the run while squaring shoulders to target
drills.key: Teach the QB to avoid throwing off their back foot while sprinting to the edge

drills.name: Offense RB: Handoff Mesh & Ball Security
drills.desc: QB takes snap, opens to correct side, seats ball in RB's stomach. RB forms proper pocket (inside elbow up, outside elbow down), clamps down softly, and bursts through designed hole
drills.key: At the 8U/10U level, ball security is paramount. Create a 'no daylight' rule—there should be no space between the ball and the ribcage

drills.name: Offense RB: Downhill A/B Gap Press
drills.desc: Place bags simulating linemen. RB takes the handoff and attacks the A or B gap immediately. RB must hit the hole without dancing, press downhill, and plant foot to cut off blocker's hip
drills.key: Stop the youth habit of bouncing every play outside. Emphasize attacking the line of scrimmage with shoulders square

drills.name: Offense RB: Running Back Gauntlet
drills.desc: Line up 4-6 players holding hit shields creating a tight chute. RB takes handoff, secures football with 4 points of pressure (high and tight), drives knees through heavy contact, maintains balance, and accelerates out
drills.key: Tell the backs to keep their pad level low and keep their legs churning through the bags. If they stop their feet, they fail the drill

drills.name: Offense RB: Outside Zone / Sweep Track
drills.desc: Set cones marking a wide track. RB takes a toss or wide handoff, runs flat down the line, and cuts upfield outside the last cone
drills.key: Force the defense to flow laterally before planting the outside foot and exploding north and south

drills.name: Offense RB: Pass Protection & Blitz Pickup
drills.desc: RB steps up into A/B gap, square shoulders, strike oncoming linebacker in the chest plate, and anchor
drills.key: Meet the blitzer at the line of scrimmage; do not wait in the backfield. Strike with the heel of the hands

drills.name: Offense OL: 6-Inch Power Step & Board Fit
drills.desc: O-Linemen align in 3-point stance straddling board with blocker shield. Fire out 6-inch power step, strike chest plate with thumbs up
drills.key: The 6-inch step prevents kids from over-striding and losing their balance. Teach them to strike with the heels of their hands

drills.name: Offense OL: Drive Blocking & Chute Drills
drills.desc: Explosion steps staying under the chute. Keep thumbs up, elbows tight, and legs driving through contact
drills.key: Low man wins. The chute forces them to play with proper pad level, which is critical since young linemen tend to stand straight up off the snap

drills.name: Offense OL: Pulling Guard & Trap Technique
drills.desc: Execute flat pulling footwork across formation, locate kicking target (DE/LB), and deliver blow with inside shoulder
drills.key: If they bow out too deep in the backfield, they will collide with the running back. Emphasize staying tight to the center's heels

drills.name: Offense OL: First 2 Steps Progression
drills.desc: Linemen line up in 3-point stance. Practice first 2 explosive steps on air on cadence: drive block step, reach step, down block step, or scoop step
drills.key: Muscle memory for footwork. Focus on taking a lateral angle for a reach block without standing up

drills.name: Offense OL: Shock & Shed (Block Defeat)
drills.desc: Lineman strikes a blocker with violent hands, extends arms to gain leverage, locates ball carrier, and rips off the block to make the tackle
drills.key: Use for two-way players. Emphasize full arm extension to keep the offensive player off the chest plate

drills.name: Offense WR: Stance & Release Package
drills.desc: Receivers line up in proper 2-point stance (inside foot up). Speed release and square cut release off the line of scrimmage against press coverage. Explode off the line for 5 yards without any false steps or rocking
drills.key: Drive off the front foot instantly. No backwards rocking

drills.name: Offense WR: Route Tree Landmarks
drills.desc: Run precise depth routes (Slants at 5 yds, Outs at 10 yds, Curls at 12 yds) planting on correct foot
drills.key: Focus on sharp cuts at the correct yardage depth rather than rounding off the corners

drills.name: Offense WR: Stalk Blocking
drills.desc: WR sprints 5 yards at a defender, breaks down, buzzes feet, and engages the chest plate to block for a run play
drills.key: Keep their feet chopping like a basketball defender. If their feet stop, the defender will easily shed the block

drills.name: Offense WR: Catch & Tuck (Gauntlet)
drills.desc: WR catches a pass over the middle and instantly tucks the ball away while running through two coaches holding pads
drills.key: Look the ball all the way into the tuck before anticipating contact

drills.name: Offense WR: Receiving Technique & Diamond Hands
drills.desc: Players run short routes. Catch with hands, never with body. Diamond hand shape (thumbs and index fingers touching) for chest/high balls; pinkies touching for balls below waist
drills.key: Youth players often try to body-catch everything. Force them to extend their arms and take a picture of the ball through their diamond fingers

drills.name: Offense TE: Inline Drive Block & Seal
drills.desc: Engage Defensive End with tight base, drive helmet across bow, and seal B-gap on inside runs
drills.key: Keep a wide base to prevent getting thrown off balance by a slanting defensive end

drills.name: Offense TE: Seam Release & Reroute Read
drills.desc: Release vertical up the seam past outside linebacker while reading zone coverage dropping underneath
drills.key: Identify if the LB is playing physical. Use a quick swim move to avoid the jam before looking back for the ball

drills.name: Offense Group: Individual Stance & Alignment
drills.desc: Skill and line players work on correct 2-point or 3-point stances, splits, and alignment rules
drills.key: Crucial foundational drill. Do not move to active plays until every player can align legally on the LOS

drills.name: Offense Group: QB & Center Exchange
drills.desc: Centers and QBs pair up. Execute 20 perfect snaps under center (dead ball snap, firm into QB palm) followed by 20 shotgun snaps
drills.key: Repetition builds muscle memory. Center immediately assumes pass/run block posture after snap

drills.name: Offense Group: Offensive Play Install (Walkthrough)
drills.desc: Huddle the full 11-man offensive unit. Walk through new plays vs. garbage cans or scout defense. No pads/helmets
drills.key: Mental reps. Everyone must know their assignment, alignment, and motion rules before going live

drills.name: Offense Group: Full Offensive Install & Skelly
drills.desc: Install weekly run scheme and passing concepts against scout team defense in 7-on-7 and 11-on-11 jog-throughs
drills.key: Timing and spacing. WRs must run to their exact depths, and the QB must read the coverage shell

drills.name: Offense Group: 11-on-11 Run Game Scrimmage
drills.desc: Live blocking and tackling. Offense runs strictly inside/outside run plays vs the starting defense
drills.key: Game simulation. Focus on line communication and hitting the correct hole at full speed

drills.name: Defense DL: DL Stance & Shock (First-Step Strike)
drills.desc: Line up in low, staggered 3-point stance 6 inches off sled. On ball movement, fire out with 2 short foot-churning steps. Shoot hands violently upward into blocker's chest right below armpits with thumbs up and elbows in
drills.key: Reaction time is key. Use a football on a stick to teach them to move on the ball, not on the offense's cadence

drills.name: Defense DL: DL Slant & Rip (Vertical Penetration)
drills.desc: On snap, take explosive vertical power step across LOS into slanting gap. Strike with inside arm, dip shoulder, execute violent vertical rip with outside arm (bicep-to-earhole)
drills.key: Execute the move vertically. Clear hip at 1 yard deep, flatten pursuit angle ('pinch'), and tackle

drills.name: Defense DL: DE Containment Stiff-Arm Track
drills.desc: Fire vertically across LOS. As blocker climbs, strike blocker's outside shoulder with locked-out rigid inside arm. Keep outside arm and shoulder high and completely free
drills.key: The most important rule for young edge players: Never get reached and never let the ball carrier outside of your outside shoulder

drills.name: Defense DL: DE Backside Squeeze & Settle
drills.desc: DE takes initial vertical containment read step. On diagnosing flow away, transition immediately to backside rule: squeeze down LOS, settle at containment depth 2 yards deeper than deepest back, shuffle parallel to LOS watching QB
drills.key: 'Squeeze & Check Boot/Reverse': Squeeze down the LOS to the depth of the QB. Do not chase flat from behind

drills.name: Defense DL: Nose Guard Bull & 2-Gap Strike
drills.desc: NG aligns 0-Tech opposite Center with pad. Fire low, strike breastplate, lock out arms, peek into A-gap of ball flow, and shed
drills.key: Pad level is king!. The lower man wins the A-gap collision every single time

drills.name: Defense DL: Defensive Tackle Shed & Spill
drills.desc: DT vs offensive guard with shield attempting base block. Strike with violent hands, drop hips, rip through outside arm into B-gap
drills.key: 'Violent Hands!'. Create separation instantly so the guard cannot reach your chest

drills.name: Defense DL: Down-Block Squeeze & Spill
drills.desc: OT down-blocks on DL while OG pulls. DL reads down-block, presses into OT hip to squeeze hole, spills play wide
drills.key: Never get reached!. If DL gets driven backward, interior run lane opens up

drills.name: Defense LB: ILB 6-Inch Freeze Step
drills.desc: Pre-snap: balanced knees bent, chest over toes, eyes on near running back. On snap, take rapid 6-inch forward control step (freeze step) keeping low hip level and nose over toes
drills.key: Do not commit blindly. Diagnose true ball carrier / play-action before committing

drills.name: Defense LB: ILB Mirror & Scrape (Inside-Out Flow)
drills.desc: RB flows laterally. LB shuffles with short choppy strides keeping shoulders square to field. Stay exactly 1 step behind runner's inside hip. Explode downhill when runner cuts vertical
drills.key: Teach linebackers not to over-pursue. If they cross the runner's face laterally, cutback lanes open up instantly

drills.name: Defense LB: Shock, Shed & Fill
drills.desc: LB steps downhill to meet lead blocker, delivers a heavy two-hand strike to the chest, sheds using a rip move, and fills the gap
drills.key: LBs must attack the blocker on their side of the line of scrimmage. Don't catch blocks; deliver the blow

drills.name: Defense LB: OLB Leverage Step & Key Read (Sweep vs Kickout)
drills.desc: Take explosive leverage step forward-lateral with inside foot. Read EMOL and near back flow. Sweep: turn hips and sprint to high-outside contain. Kickout: step downhill, squeeze edge, strike kicker
drills.key: Keep shoulders square to sideline. If you turn your back, ball turns corner

drills.name: Defense LB: 45-Degree Drop & Break Drill
drills.desc: Coach raises ball (high hat). LBs open hips 45 degrees to zone depth (8-10 yds ILB, 10-12 yds OLB). Coach slaps ball; LBs plant and drive
drills.key: Do not backpedal!. Opening hips allows maximum speed with vision on QB

drills.name: Defense LB: Pass-Off & Robot Crosser Drill
drills.desc: OLB jams/reroutes crosser, calls 'In! In!'. ILB picks up crosser, carries across zone, calls 'Out! Out!' to opposite LB
drills.key: Communication is mandatory!. Never let receiver cross zone untouched

drills.name: Defense LB: Backside Scrape & Cutback Vice
drills.desc: Playside LB pushes wide; Backside LB takes controlled shuffle steps, reads pulling guard, and mirrors inside hip leverage to execute vice tackle
drills.key: Do not cross your feet when shuffling!. Keep a wide base to plant and drive instantly

drills.name: Defense DB: Fast Alley Trigger & Breakdown
drills.desc: FS takes 2 downhill read steps, inside-out pursuit angle, chops feet at 3 yds, clamps near hip
drills.key: 'Never Cross Near Hip!'. Stay inside. If you run too wide, runner cuts back inside

drills.name: Defense DB: Centerfield Post Break & Intercept
drills.desc: FS in center field vs deep post/seam. FS backpedals. Coach loads to throw. FS plants outside foot, drives 90 degrees across hashes, beats WR to catch point for interception
drills.key: Break on shoulder turn!. In Cover 3, do not wait for ball release—jump throwing lane early

drills.name: Defense DB: DB Backpedal & Break (45-Degree Drive)
drills.desc: DB backpedals smoothly for 10 yards with low hips and chest over toes. On coach's visual/verbal signal, plant back foot, drive forward at 45-degree angle with zero false steps, accelerate, and catch
drills.key: Young DBs tend to stand straight up in their pedal. Emphasize a low center of gravity so they can transition into a sprint without taking false steps

drills.name: Defense DB: Deep 1/3 Cushion & Route Bail
drills.desc: Corner aligned 6 yds off WR running vertical. Open 45 degrees in side-shuffle bail keeping 3 yds vertical cushion over receiver
drills.key: 'Keep the Roof on!'. If receiver breaks cushion, turn and sprint to regain depth

drills.name: Defense DB: DB / OLB Defeat Stalk Block & Force
drills.desc: Defender reads run flow, attacks approaching WR's stalk block. Delivers firm two-hand punch to WR's chest, rips outside arm free, and maintains outside leverage to force runner inside
drills.key: Never get hooked inside!. Maintain outside leverage at all costs to force the ball to pursuing teammates

drills.name: Defense DB: Tip & Overturn Turnover Drill
drills.desc: 3 DBs in tandem line, 5 yards apart. Lead DB jumps and tips high pass. Trailing DB tracks deflection, calls 'Ball! Ball!', catches, and sprints 15 yds
drills.key: Finish the play!. Every interception ends with two hands high and tight

drills.name: Defense Group: 11-Man 'Liz' Pursuit Drill
drills.desc: Full 11-man defense executes run fits and inside-out pursuit angles on perimeter sweep. Every player must touch runner
drills.key: Rule number one: 'Never follow same color jersey'. Take your own lane to the ball carrier to prevent getting walled off

drills.name: Defense Group: Team Pursuit Angle Drill (11 Sideline Cones)
drills.desc: 11 cones spaced 2-3 yards apart along sideline from LOS to deep secondary. Defense fires off on ball movement. Coach blows whistle; all 11 defenders turn and sprint to their designated cone lane to form a wall
drills.key: This completely cures the 'swarm' mentality typical in youth football by visually teaching them that holding their specific lane creates an inescapable defensive wall

drills.name: Defense Group: Stay at Home Counter Fit Drill
drills.desc: Defense lines up with Backside DE, Backside ILB, and Backside OLB. Offense runs Counter. Backside ILB shuffles, reads pulling Guard, stays square, and fills counter hole downhill. Backside DE squeezes and contains boot
drills.key: 'Read Linemen, Not Eye Candy!'. If the Guard pulls across face, follow his hip directly to the ball

drills.name: Defense Group: The Alley 'Vice' Tackle Drill
drills.desc: 1 OLB (Force), 1 ILB (Spill), 1 RB with blocker. RB attacks alley. ILB spills RB wide; OLB turns RB in. Both compress and execute two-man vice tackle
drills.key: Wrap and drive!. Clamp near hip with active driving feet

drills.name: Defense Group: 7-Man Defensive Coverage Drill
drills.desc: 7 defenders align in base Cover 3 or Cover 1. Walk through and execute pass drops (curl-to-hook, curl-to-flat, deep thirds). Communicate route handoffs, pass off crossers, and break on thrown ball
drills.key: Communication is mandatory!. Never let receiver cross zone untouched

drills.name: Defense Group: Full Defensive Install & Run Fits
drills.desc: Install base 4-4/5-3 fronts, gap assignments, stunt checks, and secondary coverages against scout offense
drills.key: Walk through defensive alignments, blitz calls, and gap responsibilities against a scout offense at half-speed

drills.name: Defense Stunt: 4-4 Slant Liz
drills.desc: Entire defensive line slants one gap to the Liz (left) side on snap. E9 attacks C/D, T3 slants into Left B, T1 slants into Left A, E5 slants inside into Right B. LBs adjust
drills.key: Call on strong-side run tendency to the Liz (TE) side; shuts down off-tackle power and sweeps

drills.name: Defense Stunt: 4-4 Cross Liz (Interior Tackle Cross)
drills.desc: T3 slants across Center into Right A-gap. T1 slants across Center into Left A-gap (scissor cross in the middle). DEs fire straight upfield with aggressive outside edge contain
drills.key: Call against inside zone, ISO, and A-gap trap teams; confuses Center/Guard blocking rules

drills.name: Defense Stunt: 4-4 Fan Liz
drills.desc: T3 slants outward into Left B-gap; T1 slants outward into Right B-gap (Tackles 'Fan' out away from Center). DEs fire upfield. ILBs read Fan action and shoot downhill into vacant Left and Right A-gaps
drills.key: Call against off-tackle runs, B-gap power, or QB sneak/A-gap dive tendencies

drills.name: Defense Stunt: 4-4 Pinch Rip
drills.desc: All 4 DL pinch hard inside (E5 to B/C, T1 to Weak A, T3 to Strong A, E9 to Strong C). OLB Rover rushes/forces weak edge. ILBs fill B/C gap alleys vacated by pinching defensive linemen
drills.key: Call against interior runs (Fullback dive, Iso, QB sneak) when offense attacks the Rip side

drills.name: Defense Blitz: 4-4 Double Dog 0 Liz
drills.desc: 'Double Dog' - Both ILBs fire downhill on snap through A/B gaps right to the QB in Cover 0 man coverage. DL contain outside rush and slant inside
drills.key: Call on 3rd & Long passing downs, clear passing sets; forces immediate throw under duress

drills.name: Defense Blitz: 4-4 Blow Sting Liz (Edge Call)
drills.desc: Edge calls ('You'/'Me') coordinating DE crash and OLB blitz pressure with man coverage assignments across the board. 'ME' = OLB contains outside, DE crashes. 'YOU' = DE contains outside, OLB blitzes inside
drills.key: Call on high-leverage 3rd down; disrupts protection schemes via edge twist

drills.name: Tackling: Breakdown Fundamentals (Feet-Squeeze-Sink-Hands)
drills.desc: Players start in athletic stance. 1. Feet: shoulder-width apart, light on toes. 2. Squeeze: shoulder blades pinched, chest proud. 3. Sink: lower hips into a coiled power position (holsters). 4. Hands: hands up in holsters ready to strike
drills.key: This is the foundation of safe tackling. Do not let players advance to contact until they can perfectly demonstrate this swooping, coiled posture on command

drills.name: Tackling: Swoop Position Progression
drills.desc: Start 10 yards back, sprint to cone/dummy, break down, swoop into low coiled contact posture, come to a complete controlled stop straddling dummy
drills.key: Next progression after breakdown before making contact. Prevents lunging and dropping the head

drills.name: Tackling: Near Foot Progression
drills.desc: Tackler approaches ball carrier from an angle or head-on. Enforce stepping violently with the near foot (the foot closest to the runner/strike point) right before contact
drills.key: Generates maximum power from the ground into the hips. Prevents reaching and arm tackling

drills.name: Tackling: Form Tackle Fit & Uppercuts
drills.desc: Pair up 2 yards apart. On whistle, tackler takes near-foot step, fits shoulder into target's breastplate/numbers, shoots violent double uppercuts into jersey, grabs cloth on the back, places head on opposite side
drills.key: Do not take to ground. Focus on the violent double uppercut wrap and grabbing the jersey on the back

drills.name: Tackling: Form Fit & Drive (Thud)
drills.desc: Players start 2 yards apart. On whistle, step into ball carrier, fit shoulder to numbers, wrap arms tightly around cloth, and drive legs for 3-5 steps at thud tempo
drills.key: Without taking runner to ground. Leg drive must finish the tackle

drills.name: Tackling: Pop-Up Drill for Form Tackle
drills.desc: Tackler starts on stomach or knees. On whistle, pop up explosively into breakdown, step with near foot, strike dummy/carrier with shoulder, execute uppercuts, grab jersey, and drive 5 yards
drills.key: Builds explosive hip power and rapid transition from the ground to a striking position

drills.name: Tackling: Shoot Drill (Hips & Uppercuts)
drills.desc: Start in 3-point or 2-point breakdown stance. On cadence, explode hips violently forward-upward, shooting uppercuts through target
drills.key: Feet must not be charged; power generates purely from hip uncoil

drills.name: Tackling: Hawk (Rugby) Roll Tackle
drills.desc: Defender approaches runner in open field, aims eyes at the runner's thighs/hip, clamps arms tightly around thighs, and rolls laterally with momentum to bring runner down safely
drills.key: Safety is paramount for 7U-10U. Emphasize taking the head completely out of the tackle ('eyes on the thighs'). Praise kids who wrap tight over those who try to bring big hits

drills.name: Tackling: Angle / Alley Tackle Drill
drills.desc: Runner aims for pylon or sideline cone. Defender takes an inside-out angle to intersect runner's path, breaks down into swoop position, plants near foot, and drives shoulder through runner's near hip
drills.key: Enforce stepping with the 'near foot' (the foot closest to the runner) right before contact to generate power and prevent reaching

drills.name: Tackling: Tight Angle Tackle Drill
drills.desc: Align defender against a down-blocker with a RB running off-tackle. Defender strikes and sheds the down-blocker, maintains inside leverage, takes tight angle, and form tackles RB
drills.key: Stay square to the line of scrimmage while shedding the block to maintain the correct angle

drills.name: Tackling: Angle Tackle on Green Mat
drills.desc: Ball carrier runs at half-speed along long edge of mat. Defender approaches on an angle, tracks hip, uses near foot, and completes full shoulder tackle taking runner safely down onto the mat
drills.key: Great for building confidence in younger players learning how to safely take a runner to the ground

drills.name: Tackling: Tackle Fit Line
drills.desc: Boys face partners across a line. 1st whistle = plant near foot; 2nd whistle = strike near shoulder to breastplate; 3rd whistle = wrap cloth; 4th whistle = drive legs for 5 yards
drills.key: Breaks down the tackle into isolated, controlled steps to build perfect muscle memory

drills.name: Tackling: Sideline Pin-And-Squeeze Tackle
drills.desc: Runner attempts to turn corner down sideline. Defender uses sideline as 12th defender, attacks outside shoulder, and forces runner out of bounds
drills.key: The sideline is the 12th defender. Never let the runner cut back inside toward the middle of the field

drills.name: Tackling: Leverage Form Tackle (Ring Drill)
drills.desc: Two lines facing each other 5 yards apart. Ball carrier jogs in place; tackler steps up, establishes inside leverage, and lifts through hips
drills.key: Low man wins. Teaches leg drive and maintaining a wide, powerful base after contact

drills.name: Tackling: Open-Field Angle Tackle (10x10 Grid)
drills.desc: Ball carrier runs at 45-degree angle across 10x10 grid. Defender starts opposite, takes pursuit angle, breaks down into swoop, targets near hip, clamps, and drives through
drills.key: Intersect their path. Aim for the hip, not the shoulders

drills.name: Tackling: Open Field Shimmy (Space)
drills.desc: 10x10 yard grid. Defender tracks an elusive runner, breaks down 2 yards away, and executes a safe open-field wrap
drills.key: Do not lunge. Buzz the feet, close the distance, and let the runner make the first move

drills.name: Tackling: Thigh & Drive Tackle Drill (Kneeling to Standing)
drills.desc: Start from kneeling position facing bag. Explode hips, strike bag with shoulder at thigh level, wrap arms, and drive feet forward to finish. Progress from kneeling to standing to moving player
drills.key: Isolates the hip explosion and reinforces tackling low at the thigh level

drills.name: Tackling: Fill Drill (Half-Rounds / 2 Alleys)
drills.desc: 3 half-round dummies on ground creating 2 distinct running alleys. Ball carrier runs horizontally and chooses alley 1 or 2. Defender shuffles laterally across the bags, reads runner's commitment, swoops downhill into the hole, and makes thud tackle
drills.key: Add a lead blocker to work on shock & shed while maintaining gap integrity

drills.name: Tackling: Thud, Read, Tackle Donut
drills.desc: Defender comes up to engage blocker at thud tempo, reads coach rolling tackle donut left or right, sheds block violently, and attacks/tackles the rolling donut
drills.key: Trains defenders to keep their eyes on the ball carrier while engaged with a blocker

drills.name: Tackling: Turnover Circuit (4 Groups)
drills.desc: Divide into 4 groups. Rotate every 3-5 mins. Station 1: Strip drill. Station 2: Fumble recovery (fall on it). Station 3: Tip drill (INTs). Station 4: Punch-out from behind
drills.key: Make this a high-energy, fun circuit. Teach them to cover up a fumble in the fetal position rather than trying to scoop and run in heavy traffic

drills.name: Blocking: CUFF Blocking Progression
drills.desc: 1. Coil: low balanced 3-point stance. 2. Uncoil: explosive upward hip explosion. 3. Fit: hands inside breastplate with thumbs up, elbows tucked. 4. Finish: drive legs forward through the whistle
drills.key: Hands must be inside. If hands land outside the shoulders, it's a holding penalty waiting to happen

drills.name: Blocking: Bridge Blocking Fit
drills.desc: Pairs fit into bridge blocking position: wide triangle base, elbows in, arms off body, thumbs out, back arched to stand opponent up before feet churn
drills.key: Teaches the static power position. If the back is rounded, they will lose their balance and get pushed back

drills.name: Blocking: Open-Field Blocking Drill (Space)
drills.desc: Blocker starts in stance, takes pursuit angle to meet defender in open space, breaks down, swoops, fits hands/shoulder, and drives defender for 5 yards away from play direction
drills.key: Do not go in like a missile. Break down to mirror the defender's lateral movements before engaging

drills.name: Blocking: King of the Ring (Block Destruction / Leverage)
drills.desc: Two players start in neutral position inside a 5-yard circle. On whistle, players engage using CUFF/Bridge blocking or shed moves. Winner uses low leverage and leg drive to push opponent out of ring
drills.key: Promotes physical toughness and shedding blocks in a confined space. Keep reps short and safe

drills.name: Special Teams: Kickoff Lane Spacing Drill
drills.desc: Full kickoff team lines up across 40-yard line. On kicker approach/signal, sprint 40 yards downfield maintaining exactly 10 yards of lateral spacing between all players to prevent gaps in coverage
drills.key: Young players often bunch up and chase the ball immediately. Train them to maintain their lanes until the returner commits

drills.name: Special Teams: Kick Return Wedge
drills.desc: Front blockers sprint back 15 yards, turn, and form a tight wall shoulder-to-shoulder to block for returner
drills.key: Do not block in the back. Wait for the coverage team to come to the wall, then engage.

drills.name: Special Teams: Punt Formation & Protection Install
drills.desc: Long snap to punter (12-15 yards). Linemen execute tight slide-and-fan protection, hold blocks for 2 seconds, and release downfield in designated coverage lanes
drills.key: Focus strictly on the shield blocking technique

drills.name: Special Teams: Punt Shield Protection
drills.desc: 3 players form a shield 5 yards behind line. Step inside to seal gaps, absorb rushers, and hold for 2 seconds
drills.key: Teach the shield players to step together and form a solid wall, absorbing contact rather than attacking upfield

drills.name: Special Teams: Gunner Release
drills.desc: Gunner beats jam and forces fair catch
drills.key: Avoid the jam using a rip or swim move. Sprint to the hip of the returner and force a fair catch

drills.name: Special Teams: Specialists Kicking & Holding
drills.desc: Snapper, holder, and kicker work independently on snap trajectory, holder placement (laces out, finger on top), and kicker approach steps and follow-through
drills.key: The holder controls the play. Catch the ball first, then smoothly transition it to the block/tee

drills.name: Tackle Fit on Heavy Bag
drills.desc: Reinforce boys need to be leaning forward just before impact to deliver contact to offensive player

drills.name: Thigh and Roll Tackle on Half-Round
drills.desc: Defender starts in defensive stance, explodes forward on whistle and makes a thigh and roll tackle on half-round.  Coach holds the half-round out to side.

drills.name: Chalk Talk over Water Break
drills.desc: Review transitions between 5-3 & 4-4

drills.name: Pursuit Angle Drill
drills.desc: gold and blue run plays down the field v/ air Hurry Up

Drills.Full Playbook:
9-Cone Vice Tackle Drill

Open-Field Angle Pursuit & Leverage Progression
Field Install Card
Grid: 3×3 Even Matrix (9 cones, 5 yds apart; 10×10 yd box).
Personnel: 1 Ball Carrier (● BC), 2 Tacklers (▲ D1, ▲ D2), 1 Coach (■ C).
1. Back-To-Back Start Alignment
  • • Alignment: BC and Tacklers start back-to-back at center cone (C5).
  • • Facing: BC faces North (C1–C3); D1 & D2 face South (C7–C9).
2. The Call & Sprint Dispersal
  • • Cadence: Coach calls cone targets (e.g., "C1! C7! C9!").
  • • Dispersal: All players sprint at 100% away from center to their cones.
3. Rounding & Scallop Pursuit Arc
  • • Verbal Call: Defenders yell "VICE!" as hips flip around the cones.
  • • Scallop Track: Bow the pursuit outside-in; chop feet 3 yds out.
4. Leverage & Clamp The Finish
  • • D1 (Edge): Attacks outside hip; keeps outer arm free, turns ball in.
  • • D2 (Trail): Scrapes flat; hits trail hip; shuts back door cutback.
DEFENSIVE TACKLING DRILL • 9-CONE VICE PROGRESSION (MATT HOUSE) PAGE 1 OF 2

9-Cone Vice Tackle Drill

Practice Script, Leverage Rules & Technical Points
12-Min Install
3-Phase Drill Progression

PHASE 1: 50% SPEED — TRACK & FIT 3 MINUTES

Setup: Coach assigns BC lane prior to snap (e.g., C1). D1 & D2 assigned C7 and C9.

Action: BC jogs downhill at half speed. Tacklers round cones, flip hips, yell "VICE!", and scallop their angle.

Finish: Zero Contact / Freeze. Near foot planted forward, near shoulder in hip pocket, arms locked around waist. Check body leverage.

PHASE 2: FULL SPEED — THUD & SQUEEZE 4 MINUTES

Setup: BC chooses unannounced cut lane (C1, C2, or C3) and uses game cuts. Defenders start at randomized cones.

Action: 100% sprint. Defenders throttle down 3 yards out, maintain outside/inside leverage, and converge.

Finish: Thud Tempo (No Takedowns). Explode on the rise, lock the near-hip clamp, drive feet on contact until whistle.

PHASE 3: PASS DROP RALLY TO LIVE TACKLE 5 MINUTES

Setup: D1 aligns in Hook/Curl drop; D2 aligns in Curl/Flat drop. Coach (at QB) throws checkdown pass to BC.

Action: On throw, defenders drive out of drops, shout "VICE!", scallop angles, and compress space.

Finish: Live Tackle to Ground. Game-speed execution. Roll hips through the strike and take runner to turf.

Leverage Rules Matrix
Ball Carrier Cut Play-Side Tackler Backside Tackler
Cuts Left (Cone 1 Alley) D1 (Outside Edge): Attack outside hip; keep outside arm free; turn BC inside. D2 (Inside Trail): Scrape downhill across field; track trail hip; eliminate cutback.
Cuts Right (Cone 3 Alley) D2 (Outside Edge): Attack outside hip; keep outside arm free; turn BC inside. D1 (Inside Trail): Scrape downhill across field; track trail hip; eliminate cutback.
Drives Center (Cone 2) D1: Attack and clamp left hip/thigh. D2: Attack and clamp right hip/thigh.
Essential Coaching Cues
"VICE! VICE! VICE!" Call it immediately on the cone turn so both players coordinate inside/outside pursuit.
"SCALLOP THE PATH" Bow your pursuit angle outside-in. Running a flat line gives up cutbacks.
"THROTTLE FEET" Transition from long strides to choppy steps 3 yds out to maintain base against jukes.
"NEAR FOOT, NEAR SHOULDER" Plant the same-side foot forward on contact for balance, power, and leverage.
Coaching Fault Corrections
Common Mistake Coaching Correction
Over-running Ball Carrier Defender runs too flat and whiffs on cutback. Enforce "Throttle Down" 3 yards early and keep eyes locked on trail hip.
Edge Lost to Sideline Outside tackler pinches inside too soon. Demand edge defender keeps outside arm and leg free to force BC back into help.
Head-First Contact Eyes drop at contact point. Reinforce "Eyes Through the Hips!" Strike on the rise with the inside foot forward.

playDatabase.concept: Quick hitting dive behind RG & RT with FB kicking out DT

playDatabase.name: Sweep 28 Right
playDatabase.concept: Perimeter sweep with pulling guard and FB leading on CB

playDatabase.name: Iso Power 36
playDatabase.concept: FB iso block on MLB, TB hits C-gap with power downhill

playDatabase.name: Inside Zone Split
playDatabase.concept: Zone blocking to play side with TE slicing back to seal backside DE

playDatabase.name: 25 Trap O-Guard Pull
playDatabase.concept: LG pulls across to trap upfield 3-technique DT, RB explodes A-gap

playDatabase.name: Counter 21 Reverse
playDatabase.concept: Counter footwork with backside guard and tackle pulling to kick out edge

playDatabase.name: Sweep 29 Left
playDatabase.concept: Toss sweep to the boundary with tight end seal

playDatabase.name: 12 Dive Lead Right
playDatabase.concept: Direct downhill plunge behind center and right guard

playDatabase.name: Jet Sweep Motion
playDatabase.concept: Slot WR in full speed pre-snap motion takes mesh sweep to wide edge

playDatabase.name: QB Sneak Wedge
playDatabase.concept: C and both guards form tight wedge, QB lowers pads behind surge

playDatabase.name: FB Iso Blast A-Gap
playDatabase.concept: Direct handoff to FB bursting straight into A-gap for guaranteed yard

playDatabase.name: Speed Option Pitch
playDatabase.concept: QB reads unblocked defensive end: keep or pitch to trailing RB in space

playDatabase.name: Draw Play 34
playDatabase.concept: Pass set draws defensive tackles upfield, delayed handoff cuts up middle

playDatabase.name: Bootleg Pass (Flood Right)
playDatabase.concept: Fake 24 dive, QB boots right with 3-level flood: deep corner, flat, drag

playDatabase.name: Stick Route Concept
playDatabase.concept: Slot runs 5-yard stick option, outside WR clears out, RB flares to flat

playDatabase.name: Quick Slant / Flat
playDatabase.concept: 3-step drop. Inside slant behind linebacker with flat route expanding corner

playDatabase.name: Levels Concept
playDatabase.concept: Two dig/in routes at 6 yards and 12 yards stress the middle of zone coverage

playDatabase.name: Sail Flood Right
playDatabase.concept: Go route, 12-yard out/sail, and flat route create 3-level sideline stress

playDatabase.name: Smash / Corner Route
playDatabase.concept: Outside WR runs 5-yd hitch; inside slot runs flag/corner over the top

playDatabase.name: Mesh Crossers
playDatabase.concept: Two tight shallow crossers rub man coverage, rail route by RB to boundary

playDatabase.name: PA Post-Wheel Shot
playDatabase.concept: Heavy run fake freezes safeties, WR digs post while RB wheels down sideline

playDatabase.name: Four Verticals / Rail
playDatabase.concept: All 4 receivers attack seams, inside seam converts to curl vs Cover 3

playDatabase.name: Screen Pass (RB Middle)
playDatabase.concept: O-line lets defensive rush fly past, release out to escort RB on middle screen

playDatabase.name: RB Slip Screen Left
playDatabase.concept: Tackle and center leak left to seal perimeter for slip screen

playDatabase.name: RPO Glance / Inside Zone
playDatabase.concept: QB reads conflict linebacker: handoff to inside zone or pull and throw quick glance

playDatabase.name: Philly Special Reverse Throw
playDatabase.concept: QB shifts to RB hip, direct snap to RB, reverse to WR who throws to wide open QB

playDatabase.name: Flea Flicker Deep
playDatabase.concept: Handoff to RB who pitches back to QB, defense bites run and WR streaks open

playDatabase.name: Play-Action FB Flat Leak
playDatabase.concept: Fullback pretends to lead block, slips through line into corner of endzone

playDatabase.name: Hail Mary Endzone Cluster
playDatabase.concept: 3 receivers cluster at back of endzone with 1 underneath for tip drill

playDatabase.name: 4-3 Base Cover 3 Sky
playDatabase.concept: 3 deep third defenders, SS drops into flat, solid 8-man run box fit

playDatabase.name: 5-3 Bear Front (Plug A-Gaps)
playDatabase.concept: Cover center and both guards with DTs, MLB free to roam downhill

playDatabase.name: Cover 2 Invert (SS in Flat)
playDatabase.concept: CBs drop to deep halves, safeties buzz to flats to surprise perimeter runs

playDatabase.name: Weakside Edge Crash
playDatabase.concept: Will linebacker blitzes C-gap off weak edge while nose tackle pinches strong

playDatabase.name: Match Quarters (Cover 4)
playDatabase.concept: Pattern matching rules: safeties bracket slot verticals, corners lock #1

playDatabase.name: Nickel Cover 3 Buzz
playDatabase.concept: Safety rolls into the hook/curl passing window to rob crossing routes

playDatabase.name: Tampa 2 Middle Hole
playDatabase.concept: MLB sprints deep into middle third, safeties bracket sideline halves

playDatabase.name: Double Edge Fire 3-Deep
playDatabase.concept: Both outside linebackers rush edge while defensive ends stunt inside

playDatabase.name: 6-2 Goal Line Wedge Pinch
playDatabase.concept: All 6 defensive linemen fire low into gaps, 2 LBs fill remaining daylight

playDatabase.name: All-Out 11-Man Gap Plug
playDatabase.concept: Every single defender has an assigned gap. No retreat, zero yards allowed

playDatabase.name: Boundary Corner Cat Blitz
playDatabase.concept: Cornerback blitzes off blind side boundary, safety rotates over top to cover

playDatabase.name: Victory 3-Man Rush 8 Deep
playDatabase.concept: Drop 8 players across the 10-yard line and endzone to bat down passes
